youtube.title: Test Your Website With One Key: The Tab Key Check

media.alt: A narrated screen walkthrough of the Tab key test. On the K&A Performance website a rust focus outline moves through the skip link, the menu, the phone number and Start a project; the menu and the chat window open with Enter and close with Escape; the contact form shows visible labels. On a plain test page built for the video, focus is invisible, jumps from the header to the footer, and gets trapped in a signup box. Cards list the six checks, five fixes to ask a web person for, and the WCAG 2.2 references.
The words Press Tab. What happens? on a rust band beside a close-up of the K&A Performance home page, where the Start a project button has a keyboard focus outline around it.
